title: Proposed Copyright Law Explained
content: Illustrator and artists'-rights activist Brad Holland explains the details of the proposed new copyright law. According to Holland, if this is passed, it would undermine the rights of artists in the age of the internet (link to YouTube video).Here's a written article about the same topic by Brad HollandSubmit your letter here.Sample letters.Thanks, Will Terry, Bryn Barnard, and everyone else who mentioned this
